sloka: स वानराणां मुख्यानामुत्तमाङ्गानि सर्वशः।पातयामास कायेभ्यः फलं वृन्तादिवानिलः ।। ६.९९.२ ।।
transliteration: sa vānarāṇāṁ mukhyānāmuttamāṅgāni sarvaśaḥ।pātayāmāsa kāyebhyaḥ phalaṁ vṛntādivānilaḥ ।। 6.99.2 ।।

translations.english: That leader (Mahaparsva) severed the heads of Vanara leaders from their body just as wind drops fruits from stalks.
